dict.string: AirVeil uses AirPods head motion to blur the opposite side of your screen when you turn your head. Motion is processed locally.
AirVeil processes your desktop locally to display a live directional blur. Screen frames are never recorded or uploaded.
Optional brief camera checks help AirVeil remember your screen direction after AirPods are reinserted. Images are processed only on this Mac and discarded, never recorded or uploaded.
